title: Girl, 9, Finds Roman Coin on Dog Walk
intro: 一段本地新闻节目：主持人在直播间采访九岁的 Isla、约克郡博物馆的专家和 Isla 的妈妈——Isla 遛狗时发现了一枚罗马硬币。读的时候留意现在完成时的被动：has been identified、it's been cleaned、it's been sent，说「已经被怎么样了」，结果和现在有关。

sentences.en: Now, some lovely news from York.
sentences.zh: 接下来是约克的一条好消息。
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: On Sunday afternoon, nine-year-old Isla Walsh came across a Roman coin while she was walking her dog, Biscuit.
sentences.zh: 周日下午，九岁的 Isla Walsh 遛狗 Biscuit 的时候，发现了一枚罗马硬币。

sentences.en: Isla, tell us what happened.
sentences.zh: Isla，跟我们说说是怎么回事。

sentences.en: We were near Monk Bar, halfway round our walk.
sentences.zh: 我们在蒙克门附近，遛到一半。
sentences.speaker: Isla

sentences.en: I wasn't looking for anything — it was completely by chance.
sentences.zh: 我根本没在找东西——完全是碰巧。

sentences.en: I saw something small and green, and I thought it was an old brass button.
sentences.zh: 我看见一个绿色的小东西，还以为是颗旧铜扣子。

sentences.en: Then I had a closer look, and I couldn't believe my eyes.
sentences.zh: 再仔细一看，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: The coin has now been identified as Roman.
sentences.zh: 这枚硬币现在已经确认是罗马时期的。
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: Dr Judith Barlow from the Yorkshire Museum is with us.
sentences.zh: 约克郡博物馆的 Judith Barlow 博士也在我们直播间。

sentences.en: Dr Barlow, how old is it?
sentences.zh: Barlow 博士，它有多少年历史了？

sentences.en: Well, it dates back to around AD 210.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约可以追溯到公元 210 年。
sentences.speaker: Dr Barlow

sentences.en: At that time, the Emperor Septimius Severus was actually living here in York.
sentences.zh: 那时候，罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁其实就住在约克。

sentences.en: And are coins like this found very often?
sentences.zh: 像这样的硬币常能找到吗？
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: There's plenty of Roman history under our streets, but coins like this are rarely found by members of the public.
sentences.zh: 我们的街道底下埋着大量罗马时期的历史，可这样的硬币很少被普通人找到。
sentences.speaker: Dr Barlow

sentences.en: Honestly, it sounds like something from a children's book.
sentences.zh: 说真的，听着就像童话书里的故事。

sentences.en: And it's a lovely way for children to get to know the history of their own city.
sentences.zh: 而且这是让孩子们了解自己城市历史的好办法。

sentences.en: So what's happened to the coin since Sunday?
sentences.zh: 那从周日到现在，这枚硬币怎么样了？
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: So, the family emailed me a photo at nine on Sunday night, and I wrote back, "I'm on it."
sentences.zh: 是这样，周日晚上九点，他们家给我发了张照片，我回了一句：「马上处理。」
sentences.speaker: Dr Barlow

sentences.en: They put the coin in a sandwich bag, just in case, and handed it over on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 他们把硬币装进一个三明治袋，以防万一，周一上午就交给了我们。

sentences.en: Since then, it's been cleaned by our experts.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我们的专家已经把它清洗过了。

sentences.en: And now it's been sent to the British Museum for more tests.
sentences.zh: 现在它已经送到大英博物馆，做进一步检测。

sentences.en: And is it worth much?
sentences.zh: 值钱吗？
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: About three hundred pounds.
sentences.zh: 300 英镑左右吧。
sentences.speaker: Dr Barlow

sentences.en: Fiona, you're Isla's mum — how does the family feel?
sentences.zh: Fiona，你是 Isla 的妈妈——你们全家现在什么感受？
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: Oh, we're thrilled.
sentences.zh: 哎呀，我们都高兴坏了。
sentences.speaker: Fiona

sentences.en: We keep meaning to visit the museum, and now we've got a very good reason!
sentences.zh: 我们一直说要去博物馆看看，这下总算有个特别好的理由了！

sentences.en: The coin will go on display at the Yorkshire Museum next spring.
sentences.zh: 这枚硬币明年春天将在约克郡博物馆展出。
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: So, Isla, will you keep looking?
sentences.zh: 那么 Isla，你以后还会接着找吗？

sentences.en: Well... I have to admit, it was actually Biscuit who found it.
sentences.zh: 嗯……我得承认，其实是 Biscuit 找到的。
sentences.speaker: Isla

sentences.en: I just took it out of his mouth.
sentences.zh: 我只是把它从它嘴里拿出来而已。

sentences.en: Isla's dad is more positive.
sentences.zh: Isla 的爸爸倒是挺乐观。
sentences.speaker: Presenter

sentences.en: Biscuit's been given a new job.
sentences.zh: Biscuit 这下有新工作了。
sentences.speaker: Mr Walsh

cards.note: to find something or meet someone when you are not looking for them
cards.tip: come 的过去式是 came；碰到的东西放在后面：come across a problem，不拆开说 come it across。
cards.example: I came across some old photos while I was cleaning the flat.

cards.note: in a way that was not planned
cards.tip: 和第 19 课的 by coincidence 意思接近；by chance 更常用，放在句末最自然。
cards.example: We met by chance at the airport.

cards.note: 衣服上的扣子和机器、App 上的按钮都叫 button。
to be very surprised by something you see
cards.tip: your 要换成对应的人：I couldn't believe my eyes / She couldn't believe her eyes；讲过去的事用 couldn't。
cards.example: When I saw the bill, I couldn't believe my eyes.

cards.note: identify sth as … 认定某物是……；名词 identification，简称 ID。
to have existed since a particular time in the past
cards.tip: 说东西本身的年代，用一般现在时：It dates back to 1920，不说 It dated back。
cards.example: This pub dates back to the 16th century.

cards.note: 放在名字前面时首字母大写：the Emperor Augustus。
a lot of; more than enough
rare（稀有的）的副词；本身带否定意思，不再加 not。
和专家、工作人员相对的「普通人」；open to the public 对公众开放。
used to say what you think something is, from what you hear
to spend time with someone so that you learn more about them
used to say that you have started dealing with a problem or task
cards.tip: 口语，回复请求时用，说明自己马上处理；只能单独当一句话说。
cards.example: "Can someone check the server?" "I'm on it."

cards.note: because something might happen
to give work or responsibility for something to another person
cards.tip: 和第 41 课的 hand sth in 比：hand in 是交给负责收的人（失物处、老师），hand over 是把东西或工作转给别人。
cards.example: Before my holiday, I handed the project over to Arjun.

cards.note: 后面直接接钱数，不加 of：worth £300；问值不值钱就说 Is it worth much?
to be very happy and excited about something
cards.tip: 比 happy 强得多；对什么高兴用 about / with，或接 to do：I'm thrilled to be here。英式英语里 family 后面动词可用复数。
cards.example: We were thrilled when we heard the news.

cards.note: to plan to do something many times but not actually do it
cards.tip: 带着一点自责；后面接 to do：keep meaning to reply，不说 keep meaning replying。
cards.example: I keep meaning to call my grandmother.

cards.note: put in a public place so that people can see it
cards.tip: be on display 在展出（状态），go on display 开始展出（变化）；put sth on display 把某物拿出来展示。
cards.example: Her paintings are on display at the library this month.

cards.note: 后面可以接 that 从句，也可以接 doing：admit that I was wrong / admit making a mistake。
